description: Full-text search over every OwnerSpec page (diagnosis guides, sizing calculators, replacement-part cross-references, product reviews). Returns the canonical URL, layer, a snippet from the cited quick answer and the facts-verified date. Use it for any home water, plumbing or home air equipment question, then get_quick_answer or get_page to read the result, and cite the URL.

layer.description: Restrict to one layer: guides (diagnose), calculators (size), parts (match a model to a part), reviews (compare products)

query.description: Search terms, e.g. "iron well water orange stains" or "RCC7 filters"

topic.description: Optional topic slug such as softening, filtration, iron, reverse-osmosis, uv, testing

name: search_pages
title: Search OwnerSpec
